text: China’s trade surplus surpassed $1.07T despite an eight-month contraction in direct exports to the U.S., as outbound shipments rerouted to the EU and ASEAN beat forecasts. The data exposes the limits of bilateral tariff containment, revealing surplus preservation through multi-node trade geometry even amid weak imports, housing drag, and rising global trade frictions.

meta.note: Pressure missed global trade's load-bearing layer; routes adapted without volume loss, exposing leverage decay.

text: IBM's $11B acquisition of Confluent installs real-time data streaming as a centralized control plane for enterprise AI, retrieving a proven external capability into the core stack to align data governance, security, and agent execution while maintaining continuity across IBM's recent infrastructure-led M&A arc.
